answer.explanation: Every CompressionFunction invocation in the window fails with AccessDenied on s3:PutObject to the output bucket, stating that no identity-based policy allows the action. The IaC template grants s3:PutObject on OutputBucket/* through the CompressionRole 'WriteOutput' statement. The live inline policy 'app-policy' on lambda-rca-bench-CompressionRole-tNi3wsTWkCVs contains only ListInput (s3:ListBucket) and ReadInput (s3:GetObject). The WriteOutput statement is missing, so the live IAM role has drifted from the intended state. The function's live configuration matches the IaC, so this is not a CONFIG or IAC issue. The other three functions show no errors in the window.
